summary: BrasilAgro filed a 6-K attaching a call notice for its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting (AGM/EGM) to be held digitally on October 21, 2026. The AGM agenda covers approval of fiscal-year 2026 accounts, distribution of BRL 30 million in interim dividends, election of Fiscal Council members and management compensation limits. The EGM agenda seeks approval of the merger of Agrifirma Agro Ltda. into BrasilAgro, ratification of Athros Auditores Independentes as appraiser, and approval of the book-value appraisal report. This is a routine meeting notice, though the Agrifirma merger will be voted on; watch for shareholder approval and dissident rights.
